brief: The canvas depicts a dramatic, high-contrast nighttime cityscape viewed from across a busy harbor. Sleek drones navigate the space, casting light across the water and the surrounding buildings. The scene remains static until the user moves their mouse cursor. When the cursor hovers over specific regions of the harbor or city, the drones instantly execute complex, geometric maneuvers, forming temporary, structured arrangements before dispersing back into flight paths.

statement: This sketch renders a static nighttime cityscape with sleek drones navigating between towering buildings and across a dark harbor. The scene is deliberately motionless until a viewer moves their mouse over specific regions of the harbor or city, triggering complex geometric formations in which the drones temporarily arrange themselves into structured patterns before dispersing back into flight. The visual design emphasizes high contrast, volumetric lighting effects, and clean architectural forms to evoke a futuristic urban environment viewed from across the water.
